_comment: Proposed track for plans that have no track in plans/hackathon-3-workstreams.md (the appendix predates later plans). Used only by the progress visual (progress.json); plans.json and the existing website keep the workstream assignments. Proposals are marked 'proposed' in the visual until a plan is added to the workstreams appendix. Track ids: 0 Shared Infrastructure, 1 GIAS Planning, 2 Evidence Collection & Extraction, 3 Compliance & Regulatory (monitoring), 4 Reporting & Visualisation, 5 AI Governance & QA. Based on each plan's audit domain and problem statement; needs review by the plan owners.
